hint.label: Eurasia

atoms.b:
Lemmings are small rodents that can be found in both North America and Eurasia. There is a ((lasting)) myth that lemmings jump off cliffs to commit mass suicide. Contrary to popular belief, lemmings actually do not commit mass suicide by collectively plunging themselves into the sea.
The origin of this popular yet ((misconceived)) myth most likely derives from lemmings’ ((large-scaled)), ((swarming)) migrations. Every few years, lemmings experience a large population boom. Once a ((growing)) group of lemmings becomes too large, one part of the group decides to leave to find a new home. Since lemmings can swim, they also attempt to cross ((varying)) bodies of water to find a new home. Yet, not all ((migrating)) lemmings survive the swim.
